scripts.dev:legacy: concurrently -n admin,api -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.dev:demo: env -u NO_COLOR FORCE_COLOR=1 concurrently -n api,admin,merchant -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:merchant"
scripts.dev:platform: concurrently -n api,web,merchant -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:merchant"
scripts.setup:apps: npm ci --prefix apps/api --no-audit --no-fund && npm ci --prefix apps/admin --no-audit --no-fund && npm ci --prefix apps/merchant --no-audit --no-fund && npm ci --prefix apps/web --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.maps:up: npm run maps:prepare && docker compose --file maps/compose.yml up -d --wait
scripts.maps:update: bash maps/prepare.sh --refresh && docker compose --file maps/compose.yml up -d --wait --force-recreate tileserver
scripts.routing:up: npm run routing:prepare && docker compose --file routing/compose.yml up -d --wait
scripts.routing:update: bash routing/prepare.sh --refresh && docker compose --file routing/compose.yml up -d --wait --force-recreate routing
scripts.build: npm run api:client && npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/admin run build && npm --prefix apps/merchant run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/api run lint && npm --prefix apps/admin run lint && npm --prefix apps/merchant run lint && npm --prefix apps/web run lint
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm --prefix apps/admin test && npm --prefix apps/merchant test && npm --prefix apps/web test
scripts.test:e2e: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/api run e2e:prepare && playwright test
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:print-agent && npm run test:e2e
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build && npm test
scripts.api:client: npm --prefix apps/api run openapi && openapi-typescript apps/api/openapi.json -o packages/api-contract/src/schema.ts
